title: Chapter 323: Powerful Protoss Arms
content:
Chapter 323: Powerful Protoss Arms

After Wu Qing had a general understanding of what the Zerg were about to do, the next step was to discuss the Zerg's defense zone and other matters.

"The Zerg are willing to take on the most difficult tasks!"

Wu Qing expressed his stance in advance and won everyone's favor.

All the difficulties in this world that stand in front of the Zerg need to be eliminated one by one.

Wu Qing wants the system to get another chance to exploit the loopholes in the will of the universe, which will only make it more difficult.

"The situation in the Northern War Zone has deteriorated, and several of our partners have lost their status in the clan, making it even worse!"

"We can't spare much strength to go to support. It's just right for the Zerg to go to the northern theater to take control!"

This time, it was the strong man on the human race who first proposed that the Zerg race go to the northern battlefield and control one side alone.

Wu Qing still didn't understand many things. He looked at the strong men of the goblin tribe.

"The situation in the northern war zone is indeed grim. There are several powerful ice races in the evil god's camp. The major races we can fight against have basically been knocked out of their status as major races!"

"Compared to the southern war zone, the situation in the north is very unoptimistic!"

"If the Zerg wants to take control of the northern battlefield, they must first solve the combat problems in extremely cold environments!"

"It depends on whether the Zerg are prepared for this?"

The goblin clan expert explained.

"The Zerg have a very strong ability to adapt to the environment. Of course they can cope with extremely cold environments without any problem!"

Wu Qing replied affirmatively.

Zerg and Protoss are interstellar races, and adapting to extremely cold and hot environments is a basic requirement. There are also more and more demanding environmental adaptation requirements.

It would be extremely advantageous for the Zerg to dominate the battlefield of a camp war in one direction in the world. At least all races on the northern battlefield would actually be controlled by the Zerg.

If you control one side, you will have the foundation to sweep the world.

"Do you have any comments?"

The giant giant asked.

"No objection!"

"Welcome the Zerg to the Northern War Zone!"

"..."

All the major clans present agreed, and the powerful giant clan looked at Wu Qing again.

"The Zerg agree to go to the northern theater!"

"We also hope that all our partners in the northern battlefield will support us!"

Wu Qing readily agreed to this arrangement and prepared to let the Zerg go to the northern theater.

Because the Zerg are not picky, the battle between the Zerg camp and the defense zone was quickly arranged.

"The Zerg will be responsible for all affairs in the northern theater from now on. I hope everyone will actively cooperate and take this as an opportunity to reverse the unfavorable situation in our large camp war!"

The giant giant settled the matter.

"As for the task of eliminating Weirdness, after the Zerg obtains the status of a large clan, they automatically gain the authority to go to the mezzanine world at any time. If they want to eliminate Weirdness, the Zerg can make their own arrangements!"

"We will provide a lot of information about the mezzanine world. We hope that the Zerg can eliminate as many weirdos as possible and reduce the burden on the world, so that the lives of all the major races will be easier!"

"As for the establishment of a strange affairs handling department, we must act as soon as possible. There are more and more mutants, and our internal development has been greatly affected!"

"If we lose the foundation of our territory, then everything will be empty talk!"

The giant giant continued to speak to Wu Qing.

"My clan will immediately go to the mezzanine world to fight against the weirdness!"

"Our clan will send out full-time experts to take charge of the strange affairs handling force. We will start work in various places as soon as possible. I hope everyone will provide convenience!"

Wu Qing already has some ideas for these two tasks and can execute them immediately after returning.

Next, everyone took advantage of the opportunity to gather together to discuss many major issues, so that Wu Qing who participated in the meeting had some understanding of various affairs in the local camp.

The meeting did not last long, and everyone was very busy. When the meeting was over, the giants brought a special information carrier, which contained a large amount of precious information.

"It records most of the known information in this world. Generally speaking, races have just obtained the status of a large clan and need to obtain this information based on their contribution to the camp!"

"Since the Zerg race has passed the assessment of the world rules, it must have made enough contributions. Our major races have also clearly felt some changes!"

"Therefore, this information will be given to the Zerg in advance to help the Zerg achieve greater success!"

After the giant man finished speaking, he asked someone to give the information carrier to Wu Qing.

"Thank you all for your trust!"

Wu Qing knows the weight of this thing. With this information, many secrets of this world are no longer mysterious.

The future development plans of the Zerg and Gods have the most important intelligence support.

This is also a compensation for everyone's willingness to take on the responsibility of the Northern War Zone. Even the Goblins gave a special reminder, indicating that the situation in the Northern War Zone is already very bad.

It can be seen from the fact that no one has mentioned going to other theaters to provide support. The situation in other theaters is probably not very good either.

It is so important and timely for the entire native race camp that the Zerg can shoulder this responsibility on its own.

"Although Lord Lord represents the Zerg race, he is also a human race. I hope you can come to our human race as a guest when you have free time!"

The powerful humans from the human race saw with their own eyes the insect clone possessed by Wu Qing's consciousness, and they spoke more highly of Wu Qing. When the meeting was about to end, they specially invited Wu Qing to visit the human race as a guest.

There are many things that are difficult to discuss here. Matters between various ethnic groups are usually discussed privately at another time.

With the human race taking the lead, many races sent friendly invitations to Wu Qing.

Wu Qing agreed to all of them, saying that he would visit the various tribes when he was free after this busy period.

…

The extraordinary local race camp conference ended, and Wu Qing's Zerg clone returned to the first Zerg sub-base, and then returned to the Zerg base camp through the pupa channel.

The Queen and the Archon loaded all the information in the information carrier brought back by the Zerg clone, sorted and classified it, and stored it in the information database.

The Queen sorted out the key intelligence information that Wu Qing was concerned about and passed it to Wu Qing so that Wu Qing could make reasonable plans for the future development of the Zerg and Protoss.

With the support of these extremely precious information intelligence, many secrets of this world are no longer so mysterious, and the development of the Zerg and Protoss will reduce a lot of unnecessary troubles.

Wu Qing carefully checked these information intelligence all day long and did not rush to make arrangements.

At night, the Zerg extermination troops started another battle between Zerg and Protoss.

This time the situation is somewhat different. The Zerg, which has gained the status of a great clan, has all its armies granted the right to enter the interlayer world by the world rules, and the Zerg extermination army has a small team of all-protoss seven-star soldiers.

The Zerg extermination army not only has the ability to counterattack the world where the weird is located, but also has powerful assistance.

The Zerg extermination army walked out of the lord's protection range and began to eliminate the weirdness projected from the interlayer world space.

It is called space projection, but in fact, except for those powerful weirdness, ordinary weirdness directly crosses the fragile space and comes to this world. When the day breaks, it will return to the interlayer world due to the rejection of the world rules.

This is a peculiar space rule, which is the result of the weird strong using the rules of the interlayer world to fight against the rules of this world.

It is very unreasonable, but it does exist.

The Zerg extermination army did not use the world authority to cross the fragile space to the interlayer world, but continued to lead the weirdness from the interlayer world in the same way as before.

Wu Qing learned from the information provided by the local race camp that it would be much safer for the army to enter the interlayer world directly, and generally there would not be a large number of weird gatherings.

And using the world rule authority to enter the interlayer world will be protected by the world rules to a certain extent. The weirdness of the interlayer world will regard all creatures entering the interlayer world as the weirdness of the interlayer world, so that it will not cause all weird sieges.

And like the Zerg Weird Extermination Army, the weirdness of the interlayer world will be attracted to the outside world, and the weirdness of the interlayer world will be united to besiege the creatures of this world.

The Zerg Weird Extermination Army is afraid that there are not enough weirdness, so of course it will not run to the safer interlayer world.

Space changes produce celestial phenomena, and a large number of weirdness arrives as expected.

Under Wu Qing's gaze, the combat troops of the Protoss entered the battlefield one by one to participate in the battle.

The seven-star Berserkers are integrated with their exclusive equipment. They have strong spiritual power talents and combat skills. With the blessing of exclusive equipment that integrates the great achievements of Protoss technology, their combat power has been greatly improved again.

The spiritual power of the Protoss Berserker, with the blessing of exclusive equipment, can provide a variety of powerful abilities. Among them, the spiritual energy force field possessed by all Protoss arms is the most important ability. This force field is similar to the energy shield, which can provide powerful protection for the Protoss arms.

As long as the energy shield is not broken, the Protoss arms will not be harmed.

In the way of this world, every Protoss warrior has an energy shield that is always open. Any attack must break this powerful energy shield to hurt the Protoss warrior.

In the game setting, after the energy shield of the Protoss arms is damaged, it can be restored to the strongest state by replenishing energy.

In this real world, the energy network of the Protoss and Zerg sharing system can replenish the energy consumed by the energy shield at any time.

To put it in a simple way, as long as the enemy's attack is not strong enough to break the energy shield of the Protoss arms in one blow, the Protoss arms will never be harmed.

Of course, this is an ideal state. In actual combat, if the Protoss arms are suddenly subjected to a large number of powerful attacks and concentrated fire, they may be killed. They are not invincible.

The main weapons of the Protoss Berserker are two indestructible energy light knives in the arm position. Their movements in the game are to stab left and right. In this real world, they are all martial arts masters with strong combat skills.

The seven-star strength of the Protoss Berserker flashed through the monsters of various star strengths at an extremely fast speed. All the monsters he passed by were fatally damaged by the energy light knife and disappeared in light.

Occasionally, a powerful monster attacked the Protoss Berserker, and the energy shield of the Protoss Berserker only lost a little energy and instantly recovered to the best state.

In close combat on the ground battlefield, the Protoss Berserker has almost no opponents.

Behind the seven-star Protoss Berserker is the huge seven-star Dragon Knight.

In the game world, the Protoss Berserker and the Dragon Knight belong to small units and large units respectively. When placed on the computer screen, the size difference between the two is not that big.

But in this real world, every mechanical creation of the Protoss is very large in size, and this gap is much more obvious than that of the Zerg.

The seven-star Protoss Dragon Knights are four-legged mechanical soldiers that are nearly ten meters in size. They have powerful long-range combat capabilities and can launch lightning balls that disintegrate everything.

After system optimization, the Protoss Dragon Knights have become unmanned combat arms controlled by the Archons of the Protoss Control Base, and they themselves have powerful artificial intelligence.

The Protoss Dragon Knights have three combat states: one is to fight autonomously relying on their own powerful artificial intelligence, the second is to fight under the control of the Archons of the Protoss Intelligent Brain, and the third is to fight under the control of the Protoss.

No matter which profession the Protoss is, when necessary, they can enter the Protoss' unmanned combat weapons and use their own powerful spiritual power to fight together.

Wu Qing learned that especially powerful Protoss combat weapons such as Zhongzai and Pirate Ship, under the control of the Light Executor and the Dark Templar, can exert unimaginable capabilities.

The seven-star Protoss Dragon Knight, following the seven-star Protoss Berserker, constantly shot out huge lightning balls, clearing a large area of various weirdness.

The Protoss High-level Templar, which is very similar to the magic arms of this world, has powerful plasma control capabilities. Using this control ability, they can easily fly in the air.

They have two powerful abilities and potential talents for advanced Archons of Light. Their two abilities are Ion Storm and Illusion.

Ion Storm is an extremely powerful attack ability that can manipulate all ion energy within a certain range, causing terrible damage to enemies in it. It is almost impossible for life to survive in a large ion storm.

Wu Qing looked at the ability introduction. Unlike the game setting, in the real world, the ion storm, the senior templar can carefully control the size and duration of the casting range to deal with different battlefields and reduce their own consumption.

Illusion is to create false images, to confuse the real, and to confuse the enemy.

In the game setting, it is to create two phantoms of any type of soldiers, which can be controlled but have no attack ability.

In the real world, this ability of the senior templar is very powerful. If you can create a type of soldier that is indistinguishable from the real, you can create other things. As long as this ability is used properly, its role is endless.

The external difference between the seven-star Protoss Senior Templar and the Protoss Berserker is the difference in exclusive equipment.

He raised his hand and released an ion storm covering a large area. The dense ion lightning destroyed all the creatures in the covered area.

The ion storm ended immediately to save the spiritual power of the Protoss High Templar.

A large number of weirds suddenly attacked other weirds around them. These weirds that the Zerg Queen could not parasitize and control were affected by the illusion created by the powerful spiritual power of the Protoss High Templar and started to kill each other.

It was very simple to turn the companions around you into the appearance of terrible enemies.
